cards.name: Yawgmoth's Agenda
cards.oracleText:
You can't cast more than one spell each turn.
You may play lands and cast spells from your graveyard.
If a card would be put into your graveyard from anywhere, exile it instead.

cards.name: Yawgmoth's Bargain
cards.oracleText:
Skip your draw step.
Pay 1 life: Draw a card.

cards.name: Yawgmoth Demon
cards.oracleText:
Flying (This creature can't be blocked except by creatures with flying or reach.)
First strike (This creature deals combat damage before creatures without first strike.)
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may sacrifice an artifact. If you don't, tap this creature and it deals 2 damage to you.

cards.name: Yawgmoth's Will
cards.oracleText:
Until end of turn, you may play lands and cast spells from your graveyard.
If a card would be put into your graveyard from anywhere this turn, exile that card instead.

cards.name: Yawgmoth's Edict
cards.oracleText: Whenever an opponent casts a white spell, that player loses 1 life and you gain 1 life.

cards.name: Yawgmoth's Vile Offering
cards.oracleText:
(You may cast a legendary sorcery only if you control a legendary creature or planeswalker.)
Put up to one target creature or planeswalker card from a graveyard onto the battlefield under your control. Destroy up to one target creature or planeswalker. Exile Yawgmoth's Vile Offering.

cards.name: Yawgmoth, Thran Physician
cards.oracleText:
Protection from Humans
Pay 1 life, Sacrifice another creature: Put a -1/-1 counter on up to one target creature and draw a card.
{B}{B}, Discard a card: Proliferate. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

cards.name: Yawgmoth's Testament
cards.oracleText:
Until end of turn, you may play face-up cards you own from exile.
If a card would be put into your graveyard or exile from anywhere this turn, put it on the bottom of your library instead.
